brief:
Forty-five thousand Indian workers have departed Israel, the Ma'an news agency reported. The scale of the exodus reflects a substantial reduction in the Indian labor force that has long supplied workers to Israeli construction, agriculture, and service sectors.

The departures occur as Israel reassesses its reliance on foreign labor. Indian nationals have comprised a major component of Israel's migrant worker population, filling positions across multiple industries. The reasons for the coordinated exodus and whether additional Indian workers plan to leave remain unclear from available reports.
title: Forty-five thousand Indian workers leave Israel
